note: These are DESIGN recommendations for feature sizes only. They are NOT laser power/speed settings, which depend on your machine, lens, material, coating, focus, and air assist.

presets.label: Birch plywood
presets.note: Fine grain engraves crisp small dots well.

presets.label: MDF
presets.note: Uniform surface; slightly larger minimums avoid fuzzy edges.

presets.label: Hardwood
presets.note: Grain contrast varies; medium density keeps detail readable.

presets.label: Painted wood
presets.note: Paint layer gives strong contrast for fine detail.

presets.label: Acrylic
presets.note: Frosted engrave holds very fine detail.

presets.label: Coated metal
presets.note: Marking coatings resolve the finest features of any material here.

presets.label: Custom
presets.note: Set your own minimums in the advanced panel.
